description: This file defines the HierarchicalKeyStore class, an internal class implementing ILocalDataStore for hierarchical key-value data storage with multi-tier key management within the Orleans storage framework.

classes.name: HierarchicalKeyStore
classes.description: Implements a hierarchical key-value store with multiple key layers, supporting CRUD operations and data dumping within Orleans storage system.

methods.name: WriteRow
methods.description: Stores data associated with hierarchical keys and updates ETag.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with hierarchical keys.

methods.name: ReadMultiRow
methods.description: Retrieves multiple data stores matching hierarchical keys.

methods.name: DeleteRow
methods.description: Deletes data associated with hierarchical keys and specified ETag.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all data from the store.

methods.name: DumpData
methods.description: Returns a string representation of all stored data, optionally printing a trace log.

methods.name: MakeStoreKey
methods.description: Generates a string key representation from hierarchical key pairs.
